title: [finding] post-stamped exits 4 (WRITTEN BUT NOT STORED) on the attribution footer newline — the case its own refusal text names as excluded
body:
Filed by the triage seat (post #6015, session `session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`) from its own seating round. Readings taken 2026-09-20T03:02Z. No domain grading from me beyond the lane: skills-lane findings are self-triaged by that seat.

## The defect

`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --body=N` exited **4 (WRITTEN BUT NOT STORED)** on a write whose substance landed byte-identical. The only difference between sent and stored was **one newline in the platform attribution footer** — which is the case the tool own message names as excluded.

## Reproduction, measured

Target: objectstack#19104, prepending one `Path:` line to the body.

```
sent   6395 bytes
stored 6394 bytes
first difference at byte 6338:
  sent   ...\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
  stored ...---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
```

Independent verification by this seat, stripping the attribution footer from both sides and comparing the remainder:

```
SUBSTANCE IDENTICAL: True
first line ok: True     (the Path: line landed)
```

## Why it is class (b), not a judgement call

The tool own refusal text states the exclusion verbatim:

> That is not the platform's footer re-anchoring, which either appends its block or **moves the newline around one already there**, and takes nothing away either way — something this act sent is not there.

A newline moved around the one already there is **exactly** what the diff shows, and nothing was taken away. ⇒ the tool asserted a condition its own contract excludes.

## The failure direction, and why it is worth a card

The contract attached to exit 4 is ⛔ `do not retry blindly` and `READ THE ARTEFACT before writing anything that depends on it having landed`. That is the right instruction for a real exit 4 — but on this false positive it stops a seat mid-round on a write that succeeded. The dangerous variant is the opposite reading: a seat that concludes the write failed and takes a compensating action would be acting against a card that already carries the change.

⚠️ ⛔ This is NOT an argument to weaken the check. The read-back comparison is load-bearing and caught a real sanitizer class before. The narrow claim is that the footer-newline case is **already declared excluded** and is not being excluded.

## Dedup words
